moments.author: Los Angeles Rams
moments.quote: Unveiled two new throwback‑inspired alternates: 'Classic Sol' yellow and 'Fearsome White' — celebrating our 1951 champs and Fearsome Foursome.
moments.why: Nostalgic design drop tied to Super Bowl aspirations is lighting up NFL fandom.

moments.author: Mike LaFleur
moments.quote: Jacoby Brissett is practicing with the team and contract talks are still ongoing but productive.
moments.why: QB holdout drama resolved for now; fantasy owners and Cardinals fans are hyped.

moments.author: Robert Scoble
moments.quote: The Holodeck will join us even if we live hours apart.
moments.why: Futurist vision of shared virtual spaces with Vision Pro is sparking VR imagination.
